title: The Warning Against False Teachers
speaker: Pastor Billy Philips
summary: Last week Peter grounded you in everything God has already given. This week he tells you why: a lie is coming, and it will not wear a warning label. False teaching sneaks in promising freedom and delivering chains, denying the Master who bought it and spending the flock for its own gain. But right in the middle of the warning is the hope. The Lord knows how to rescue the godly, and the Master who bought you is the Shepherd who keeps you. Test every voice, and stay planted in the truth.
subtitle: 1 and 2 Peter Week 7
